unstated.what: requestSize must be computed without accessing request.body (e.g. from CONTENT_LENGTH), since the test reads the stream before middleware runs and still expects len('hello world')
When no content length is present, requestSize may be None or 0 (either accepted)

instruction_covers: Avoid raising RawPostDataException by accessing request.body after the stream was read
Not re-reading the body across multiple logging calls in the same request
The requestSize field of the inferred http_request dict
reason: The issue text explicitly explains that body access after reading the stream raises RawPostDataException, which clearly implies the fix should derive requestSize without touching request.body (e.g. via CONTENT_LENGTH); the tests' expectations follow from that and the exception type is quoted in the issue.
